scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.format: prettier --write src/bridge/src src/bridge/test src/renderer/src/style.css scripts eslint.config.js package.json src/bridge/package.json src/bridge/tsconfig.json src/shared .github && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/bridge/src src/bridge/test src/renderer/src/style.css scripts eslint.config.js package.json src/bridge/package.json src/bridge/tsconfig.json src/shared .github && cargo fmt --all -- --check
scripts.lint: eslint src/bridge/src src/bridge/test scripts eslint.config.js && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.start: npm run build && cargo build --locked --release --package roonscape-renderer && ./src/launcher/roonscape
scripts.smoke:ipc: npm run build && cargo build --package roonscape-renderer --example ipc-probe && node scripts/ipc-smoke.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:bridge && npm run test:source-launcher && npm run test:fixture-launcher && npm run test:gallery-captures && npm run test:package && cargo test --workspace && npm run smoke:ipc
